generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can claim a preferred-versus-fallback invariant is covered while its negative evidence exercises only compatibility, rendering, or structural happy paths and never forces the competing sources to disagree.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: A lower-priority source or generic marker is selected in one branch, while unrelated compatibility tests make the overall feature appear correct.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: For every covered precedence obligation, map at least one family-specific negative control and verify that the mapped control exists, passed on the frozen head, and carries evidence.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Structural closure entries that cover precedence obligations must declare controls_by_family.precedence rather than relying on a generic structural evidence list.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The terminal handoff validator cross-checks every mapped precedence control against the requirement attack matrix and blocks missing, failed, stale-head, or evidence-free controls.

transfer_cases.case: Preferred structured data and fallback data compete in a selector; a generic structural control without a precedence mapping is rejected.
transfer_cases.evidence: Generic Skill test verifies the handoff gate blocks a precedence obligation that lacks controls_by_family.precedence.

transfer_cases.case: Two handlers can both return valid output but only one has priority; an explicit mapped precedence control is accepted when it exists and passed in the attack matrix.
transfer_cases.evidence: Generic Skill test verifies a distinct dispatch surface passes with a mapped precedence discriminant control.

skill_changes.evidence: Permanent contract now requires family-specific precedence control mapping and explains why generic structural evidence is insufficient.
Validator cross-checks controls_by_family.precedence against passed attack-matrix negative controls; focused Skill suite passed 12 tests and genericity validation passed.
